dedupe_keys.name: speed data recorded in the a 8 highway in basauri bizkaia spain during the roadworks in the malmasin tunnel in april 2024

description: The Malmasin study authors publish vehicle-speed observations during April 2024 roadworks on the A8 in Spain. Zenodo supplies CSV measurements and a text dictionary free under CC BY 4.0. Closing one tunnel barrel created bidirectional traffic in the other, with measurement points fifty and one hundred metres from the return chicane. Observations compare conditions before and after a speed display and distinguish light and heavy vehicles. These values can calibrate driver-speed responses in temporary-road-layout simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this campaign. Coverage is one work zone and observation period. Paired point records deliberately share a vehicle timestamp, so timestamp differences cannot estimate travel time. The dictionary does not state speed units, and treatment effects remain observational. No measurements were downloaded or behavioural effect estimated.
